scope.performance_scope: Complete standalone GPU SDPA call: input validation/packing, three uploads, full QK GEMM, stable row Softmax and PV GEMM, consumer-layout readback, owned finite validation and per-call event release. Init, hash/reference comparison/save/platform reads are outside.
scope.frequency_scope: Automatic GPU frequency snapshots under unchanged governor/min/max; between-call GPU samples belong to the external controller, not a fixed/sustained-clock claim.
scope.timing_limit: CPU wall durations include host scheduling; the external GPU controller does not pause submitted work. Event durations are recorded separately. Standalone original CPU operands are not the compiled whole-block boundary.
